name: Hofbräu Ceramic Beer Mug
about: This is the official brewery mug with the Hofbräu logo, a classic Munich souvenir from the city's most famous beer hall.
tip: Ornate lidded mugs cost much more, so choose a plain one if you want a budget-friendly keepsake.

name: Dallmayr Coffee
about: Dallmayr is a long-established Munich food shop, and its local roasts and blends are a well-known taste of the city.
tip: Pick from the local roasts and blends in the shop to find one you like.
